items.title: Jim Cramer Calls Cloudflare “the Most Expensive Stock in the Market.” He Still Prefers It
items.summary: Key TakeawaysJim Cramer told a Mad Money caller he likes Cloudflare more than Akamai, even though he called Cloudflare “the most expensive stock in the market. ”Cloudflare trades at 169x forward earnings against 12x for Akamai, after growing 39% in the third quarter while Akamai grew 6%.

items.title: AKAM Q3 2026 deep dive: cloud infrastructure contracts expand as near-term guidance softens
items.summary: Cloud technology company Akamai Technologies (NASDAQ:AKAM) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 6.4% year on year to $1.12 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1.16 billion was less impressive, coming in 3.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.77 per share was 5.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
